summary: Both backend and frontend tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed including Claude Sonnet 4.5 vision /api/scan-screenshot end-to-end (extracted amount=487.5 and merchant=Swiggy from a generated UPI screenshot). All CRUD for expenses, dashboard aggregation, budget upsert+spent computation, and category filter/search verified. Frontend: home dashboard, tab navigation, add-expense manual flow, transactions list/edit/delete, budgets set+progress bar, insights bar chart and top-categories all working. Manual entry save updates dashboard and donut chart. Edit modal updates expense (350->999) and reflects in list and totals. Budget set (Food=5000) shows progress with 'left' amount. No red screens, no API failures.

react_native_issues.issue: Stack.Screen name="budget-edit" is registered but no app/budget-edit.tsx route file exists, producing console warning 'Layout children: Too many screens defined. Route "budget-edit" is extraneous.' Remove the Stack.Screen entry or create the route. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:38-41

Console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from tab bar/FAB shadows (e.g. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:115-118). Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents for RN web.

action_items: Remove the extraneous Stack.Screen name="budget-edit" entry in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (or create the corresponding screen). It produces a runtime warning on every load.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean and well structured. _id is excluded via projection or pop. Categories are validated against the fixed enum. ScanResponse falls back to category='Other' on errors so the UI never breaks. Good use of upsert pattern for budgets.
Backend uses correct emergentintegrations.LlmChat with model 'anthropic'/'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' and ImageContent base64 path; markdown-fence stripping in _extract_json_blob is robust.

Frontend src/api.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix. testIDs are present on all interactive elements (form-amount, form-merchant, form-save, tx-row-*, chip-*, edit-budget-*, save-budget-*, etc.).
seed_data_creation: Tests create/delete their own TEST_-prefixed expenses and budgets; all cleaned up after each class. No persistent seed data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://smart-receipt-parser-2.preview.emergentagent.com). pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers categories, expenses CRUD+filters, dashboard, budgets upsert+spent, and scan-screenshot with a generated realistic UPI image (PIL JPEG). Scan test makes a real Claude call (~5s). UI tested with mobile viewport 390x844; key testIDs: home-screen, transactions-screen, budgets-screen, insights-screen, add-screen, add-fab-button, add-option-manual, form-amount, form-merchant, form-cat-{Cat}, form-date, form-save, tx-row-{id}, chip-{cat}, edit-amount, edit-save, edit-delete, edit-budget-{cat}, budget-input-{cat}, save-budget-{cat}. Upload-screenshot UI couldn't be exercised via Playwright (web ImagePicker), but the scan endpoint is verified end-to-end and add.tsx wires it correctly into form fields.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only a benign 'extraneous route' warning caused by a Stack.Screen entry without a matching file.
